_help: Edit this file on GitHub (pencil icon) before the weekly draft builds, or edit it and re-run 'Weekly letter draft'. Leave any text blank to let the system write a mechanical version; the approval issue tells you which parts are machine-written. Keep the file valid JSON: straight quotes, commas between items, no comma after the last item.
_help_events: Each event: {"date": "2026-12-09", "kind": "Fed", "title": "Fed decision with updated projections", "note": "What the market expects, and what would surprise"}. kind is Fed, Data, Earnings or Other. Confirm every date on the Fed, BLS or company site. Past events drop off automatically.
_help_change_my_mind: Up to four short lines in your own words, for example: "Credit spreads widen past 4%. That would turn a rotation into real risk-off." Leave the list empty to leave the section out.
_help_sector_overrides: Your own call for a sector, -2 to 2, replacing the 5-day momentum reading. The letter marks these as (author). NEO (neo-cloud and data centers) has no ETF proxy, so it only appears if you set it here.
